subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB660
title: Requires each school district, education service district and public charter school to ensure that state moneys received by the district or school are used to educate the student for which the moneys are received.
headline: SB 660 did not pass

claims.text: SB 660 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SB 660 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
